column2: Specify what project you are creating these profiles for
Specify what you are using the shapes for (what model/purpose)
time interval in minutes, i.e., '30' is half hour intervals. Valid intervals are 30 & 60 (currently only 60 is fully supported)
int (-12 to +12); timezone relative to UTC in which you want to write out the profiles. Note that NSRDB irradation data will be reported in local timezone
TRUE / FALSE; whether you want NSRDB data with leap years. Users should set this to TRUE. Note that SAM will not process leap days so they are added manually afterwards
capacity / energy; currently defaults to scaling profiles by installed capacity (energy is not used)
TRUE / FALSE; output individual project shapes
system losses in percent (soiling, shading, wiring, etc). Default 14.0757
ground coverage ratio, only applies to single axis tracking. Default 0.4
